## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Healthcare, Technology). Confirmations: very weak breadth plus clear divergence—pockets of Tech/Healthcare strength while Financials and Communications are broadly BELOW TREND.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare lead: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND. Technology next: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND. Energy shows isolated leaders MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND but sector performance mixed.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication lagging: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND. Utilities and Industrials also show broad weakness.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communications and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strong 1W movers: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: multiple large caps (ISRG, LLY, JNJ and several Financials) show 1W vs 1M mismatch → MAJOR DIVERGENCE, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but constructive: AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: +0.30% | 1M: +1.83%. Watch for concentration risk if leadership narrows.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Weak and under pressure: JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%. Financials are a material headwind for broader risk-on moves.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Short-term strength within a softer 1M: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: +1.98% | 1M: -4.67%. Multiple large-cap RECOVERY patterns suggest tactical opportunities rather than broad accumulation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to individual leaders (TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to beaten Financials and Communications (BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND) while waiting for clearer breadth improvement.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND; CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W +1.98% | 1M -4.67%) and Technology (1W +0.30% | 1M +1.83%) for idiosyncratic leadership. BEARISH: Communications (1W -5.35% | 1M -6.95%) and Financials (1W -2.93% | 1M -3.80%) for continuation of weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND sustaining 1M gains to confirm broader Tech participation; AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND holding recent 1W support would validate selective risk; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) breaching recent lows would deepen the Financials-led drag.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+70): ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY — EU nod confirms catalyst and price action confirms short-term accumulation. TMO (+60): TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND — demand commentary confirms price strength. MPC (+55): MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND — analyst upgrades/earnings beat align with strong momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BAC (-85): BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — news of bond losses confirms price weakness. CVS (-80): CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND — fraud verdict headline matches downside. NFLX (-50): NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND — downgrade and falling price confirm distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: very weak breadth (2/11 sectors positive) and MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps—monitor Financials and Communications for further downside.
